item.title: Hollywood Confused As Guy Keeps Saying 'Jesus' But Does Not Appear To Be Using It As A Curse Word
item.description: LOS ANGELES, CA — The entertainment industry was sent abuzz over the weekend after a guy at the Grammys kept saying "Jesus" but did not appear to be using it as a curse word.

item.title: Bible Study Officially Changes Name To 'Jennifer Support Group'
item.description: ATLANTA, GA — After weeks of discussion, a local Bible study has officially righted the record by changing its name to the "Jennifer Support Group."

item.title: Man Horrified To Learn ICE Has Permanent Presence At His Hotel
item.description: SALEM, OR — A hotel guest caused quite the stir at a local Holiday Inn Express this week after discovering the presence of ICE at his hotel.

item.title: Stupid Kid In 'Hakuna Matata' Shirt Doesn't Know The Film Ultimately Repudiates The Song's Message As Simba Realizes He Must Fulfill His Role In The Natural Order To End The Chaos And Suffering Caused By His Hedonistic Pursuit Of Pleasure
item.description: ANAHEIM, CA — A stupid kid visiting Disneyland in a "Hakuna Matata" shirt didn't seem to realize that, in the context of the film The Lion King, the "Hakuna Matata" song, properly understood, was communicating that living a hedonistic lifestyle is an abdication of one's God-given duty and higher purposes while barbarians usurped the throne causing chaos and suffering.

item.title: Here Are 12 Fun Crimes You Can Get Away With If You Just Say 'We Are On Stolen Land'
item.description: Stolen land is all the rage in the news lately. These days, everyone gets a free pass to do as many fun crimes as they want on land swiped from indigenous peoples, as long as they keep pointing out that the land was stolen.

item.title: Experts Conclude No Human Being Is Illegal, Except Jeff?
item.description: U.S. — In a startling turn of events, experts confirmed a statement made by Billie Eilish at the Grammys when she said that no one is illegal on stolen land. However, the experts did make a specific exception singling out Jeff.

item.title: Awesome New Streaming Service Records Movie Streams Onto Cool Shiny Discs And You Can Buy Them And Own Them Forever
item.description: U.S. — Entertainment fanatics will soon have something revolutionary to look forward to, as an awesome new streaming service will record movie streams onto shiny discs and give consumers the opportunity to buy them and own them forever.
